patterns: how do i return an item
responses: You can return items within 30 days of delivery. Go to 'My Orders' > 'Return Item'. Refunds are issued in 5-7 business days.

patterns: what payment methods do you accept
responses: We accept cards, UPI, net banking and cash on delivery. If a payment failed but money was deducted, it is refunded automatically in 3-5 days.
You can reach our support team at sharonjothi1511@gmail.com or call 1800-000-000 (9am-6pm, Mon-Sat).

patterns: how do i cancel an order
responses: You can cancel an order before it ships from 'My Orders' > 'Cancel Order'. If it has already shipped, you can return it after delivery.
